storage.built_in: 72, 96, 120, 160 or 200 TB effective by model (88 to 240 TB raw), RAID 6; OS on 2 x 480 GB M.2 SSD, RAID 1

power.supply: 100 to 240 VAC, 50/60 Hz, auto-switching; dual (1+1) 1400 W redundant

features: 4 x 10 GbE SFP+ ports in addition to the 6 x 1 GbE RJ-45 ports
Analytic channels: up to 125 Appearance Search, 50 Facial Recognition + Appearance Search
FIPS 140-2 Level 2 data-at-rest protection, FIPS-compliant ACC 7
iDRAC 9 Enterprise out-of-band management (network disabled for FIPS compliance)
notes: Channel and bandwidth maximums are stated for 10 GbE or teamed 1 GbE connections; on a single non-teamed 1 GbE connection the datasheet gives up to 100 channels at 680 Mbps.
Outgoing bandwidth is the stated livestream rate.
